description: Stage-isolated diagnostic cases. problemIds link cases to docs/model-error-taxonomy.md. Missing inputs are unavailable, never model failures.

nonModelProblemIds.16-20: provider, machine, and runner configuration failures; handled by environment preflight and runtime diagnostics, not model quality scores
nonModelProblemIds.23-24: runner regression classes; covered by deterministic server tests, not model calls

cases.evaluation: intent rubric: preserve scope, constraints, measurable acceptance criteria
contradiction rubric: detect conflict and ask before committing to either answer
required files, symbols, dependency chain, and exploration completeness
dependency graph and all affected modules
conditional skip control: copying is established by src/hold.ts and test/hold.test.ts; the model must record the choice and code evidence in plan before implementation
ask for coefficient and order of application; record the human answer rather than inventing a value
config default behavior, compatibility, and tests
correct rounding semantics, affected files, tests
clean control: no unsupported findings, accurate gate report
name the seeded configuration defect with evidence
name the seeded secret exposure with evidence
successful verify input: complete and accurate handoff
runtime safety control (not model ability): missing runtime verdict must block handoff before any model or commit
